content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom billing and operations software and services; it sells software rather than satellite connectivity or terminals."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Terrestrial rural wireless and fixed broadband carrier, not satellite connectivity or defense communications."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Utility meters, filtration and aerospace components; a manufacturer in different end markets from satellite connectivity."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise network security hardware and subscriptions; a cybersecurity business, not satellite connectivity."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"In-flight broadband and connectivity for airlines and aircraft operators over satellite networks, matching Viasat's aviation segment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Rural fiber and telephone provider serving local households; terrestrial, not satellite or aviation or defense."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Government engineering and cybersecurity services contractor; no satellite connectivity or terminal business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"IP communications and session border controller software for carriers; a telecom software vendor, not a satellite operator."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Terrestrial wireless and wireline telecom carrier serving US consumers and businesses, not satellite broadband."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Leases fiber and copper network assets to carriers, plus rural retail broadband; terrestrial infrastructure, not satellite."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Network test instruments and optical components; equipment for terrestrial networks rather than satellite services."}]}
